title: iss is an optional alpha-2 string
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 3.2.4 Issuer; QR Code Generation, 12.3 Test issuer.

statements.label: iss is an optional alpha-2 string
statements.requirement: iss SHALL be optional and SHALL be encoded as a text string. When present, the issuer SHALL require two upper-case letters, the alpha-2 form used in iss and in the DSC's X.509 C attribute.

sources.quote: GDHCN participant codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, while the CWT iss claim and the X.509 country attribute take the alpha-2 form
